status: Preparation only. No Kubernetes command or production operation has run.
workflow_gap: Current hcloud-csi-rollout.yml supports only inventory and rollout. Production acceptance needs a separate fixed fixture operation; inventory cannot take a snapshot, query own-volume physical state, or prove remount/restore completion.

proposed_dispatch.execution: main only, production-cluster environment, existing authoritative-SSH kubeconfig fetch, no Terraform/CAPI/Helm changes; one fixture concurrency group, finite request/step/workflow deadlines, credentials removed on every exit. Archive only reviewed projected evidence.

binding: REST create intent SHA256 and actual HTTP201 response
live_validation_before_every_action: Exact service name has this prepared dated QA prefix and nonce; both service and disk IDs absent from pre-create baseline and original215 historical IDs; actual201 body matches one Starter service and one inline1Gi disk at/var/data.
REST current service/workspace/name/disk binding remains unchanged; only requested size may become5Gi. Actual fixture program/source command hash must match preparation.

App serviceId label equals proved service ID; App UID unchanged; exact PVC controller ownerRef UID equals App UID; PVC UID unchanged; exact PV claimRef UID/namespace/name equals PVC; PV UID/CSI driver/volumeHandle unchanged.
StorageClass is the reviewed bounded encrypted ext4 class; current admitted request and nonsecret Secret fields agree with expected phase. Existing unrelated claims are untouched.

The single attached VolumeAttachment references only this PV, has attacher=csi.hetzner.cloud, attached=true and nodeName equal to the live App pod's node. Read only devicePath from its attachmentMetadata after this join.

Walk exact App Deployment/ReplicaSet/pod ownerRefs by UID. Require one Ready service pod for active phases, one attached node, and no previous service pod still running for remount/restore completion. Capture old/new pod UIDs from the preceding phase receipt.

For node exec, select only the CSI DaemonSet-owned Ready driver pod on this bound node, record/recheck its pod UID/containerID/imageID against the reviewed CSI digest immediately before and after each fixed exec. No exec in the tenant service pod.
required_reviewed_own_receipt.identity_change_policy: App/PVC/PV/CSIhandle lifetime mismatch fails closed. Pod, VolumeAttachment and node may change only across a declared restart/redeploy/restore phase after old-pod termination/old-attachment detach as appropriate; derive and record new VA/podUID from the same PV/PVC/AppUID, never caller input. Recheck any phase-bound currentVAUID. A same-name new App/PVC/PV never inherits authority. On uncertain create, do not adopt by prefix/name and do not create again.
required_reviewed_own_receipt.committed_ledger_gate: The sanitized ownership ledger must be committed on main and clean in the checked-out workflow ref before fixture exec or Job mutation. It contains exact actualHTTP201 evidence/sourcehash, dated name/workspace/service/disk, immutable App/PVC/PV lifetime binding and explicit expiry/actions. Initial metadata-only bind is separate from fixture exec/mutation; root records/commits the binding after the guarded REST create. No API response/fixture action is currently available or authorized.

inspect.mutations: None. No diagnostic pod, Job, PVC, volume, mount, key, Helm release or setting is created or changed.
Kubernetes_metadata_reads: GET exact App: project only UID, namespace/name, workspace/service label, disk requested size/mount, disk status, controller Deployment references and observed generation.
GET exact PVC/PV: project UIDs, exact ownership/claimRef lifetime join, storageClass, request/status capacity, CSI driver/volumeHandle, phase/deletion timestamps.
GET exact StorageClass: project UID, provisioner, boundedFilesystem and encryption-related Secret-reference templates; do not enumerate arbitrary parameter contents.
GET exact own LUKS Secret only after owner UID match; emit only metadata UID and decoded boundedFilesystem/filesystemSizeBytes. Never print/store/hash encryption-passphrase or Secret.data wholesale.
List VolumeAttachment metadata in memory, retain only exact PV+node match and its UID, attacher, attached status and attachmentMetadata.devicePath. Do not persist other attachment rows.
GET projected Deployment/ReplicaSet/pod ownership/readiness/node/image metadata only for exact App chain, and fixed reviewed CSI driver pod on the bound node. No full tenant pod spec/env/log dump.

fixed_node_exec_readonly.target: Only the current reviewed CSI driver container on the VolumeAttachment node, UID checked before/after. Hard-coded argv in reviewed code; no shell, stdin, tty, show-keys, or caller-controlled program/arguments.
fixed_node_exec_readonly.derive_device: The attachment devicePath comes from trusted CSI metadata, not workflow input. Require the reviewed /dev/disk/by-id/scsi-0HC_Volume_<positiveProviderID> grammar and matching exact provider ID parsed from bounded-ext4-v1:<ID> volumeHandle. Upstream GenerateLUKSDeviceName uses basename(devicePath); mapper path is /dev/mapper/<that basename>.
emit_only: mapped filesystem raw bytes=block count*block size
fixed_node_exec_readonly.expected: Initial/full1Gi raw ext4 blocks262144 at4096B; all grown/remount/restore phases blocks1310720 at4096B. Underlying LUKS physical minimum and same handle/device persist; no whole-device resize to10Gi. Mounted statvfs/kubelet totals may be smaller due filesystem overhead. Factory provides cryptsetup/blkid/e2fsprogs, but fixed executable availability must be checked in the exact published image; failure is an explicit missing-proof gate, no package installation/fallback shell.

metrics.transport: Finite localhost-only kubectl port-forward to fixed monitoring/svc/prometheus-server:80, killed on every exit. Alternatively fixed apiserver Service proxy route. Caller cannot choose endpoint or PromQL.
metrics.checks: Require nonempty fresh samples at each phase, bind namespace/PVC to the current UID receipt and pod/node lifetime, preserve timestamp/job/instance attribution, reject samples older than current mount/phase or stale terminated-node series. If duplicated, retain own node's series using reviewed scrape-target attribution rather than blindly sum/max. Capture at initial, full, grown, remount, restore, and after compaction. Used bytes change as expected; actual capacity agrees with own probe statvfs within filesystem accounting granularity. Requested API capacity separately remains exactly1Gi/5Gi. No synthetic config capacity substitutes for kubelet physical stats.

backup.only_mutation_needed_before_API_restore: Create exactly one uniquely named Kubernetes Job from the existing own backup CronJob. It reuses the same PVC; creates no cloud disk, snapshot volume or paid service.
preconditions: Root's rollout/budget/expiry gate authorizes own backup and exactly one backup Job.
HTTP fixture compact/hash proof persisted and snapshot_not_before timestamp recorded.

Exact CronJob UID/controller ownerRef AppUID matches reviewed binding; template contains only sole own PVC disk-<serviceID>, reviewed backup image, command/disk-snapshot args[backup], trusted object-prefix env for exact workspace/actualAppName; existing security/resource/node-affinity policy preserved.
Current same-node service pod is Ready; no matching backup/restore Job in flight; exact intended Job name absent. Never replace an existing same-name Job.
backup.create: Construct Job metadata in code with fixed dated QA name/run label, controller ownerRef to the exact own CronJob UID, and deep-copy its verified JobTemplate spec. Do not accept YAML/JSON spec from workflow input, do not override image/env/volumes/command. POST once to the exact own namespace batch/v1/jobs; save actual201 and created Job UID before waiting. If transport is ambiguous, GET only that exact name and reconcile UID/annotations/spec hash; never blindly replay.
backup.wait: GET/watch exact Job UID and its ownerUID-bound pod(s) with bounded10min wait. Record completion/failure condition, start/completion timestamps, pod UID/node/imageID, own PVC mount readOnly=true and verified same-node binding. No S3 credential values or file-content logs. The tenant snapshot API must independently list a new own-instance snapshot created after snapshot_not_before.
backup.status: backup-status reads only exact recorded Job UID+children and own snapshot API. A successful Job alone is not restore evidence.
backup.cleanup: backup-cleanup DELETE only the recorded exact Job with DeleteOptions.preconditions.uid=createdJobUID, propagationPolicy=Foreground; refuse if UID differs. Never broad label deletion. Preserve receipt through App deletion.

restore_and_remount.root_Kubernetes_mutations: None. Fixture driver already requests own REST restart, redeploy, disk grow and exact own-snapshot restore. Operator performs reconcile/scale-down/restore/restart. Do not manually edit App/PVC/Secret, restart pods or run filesystem tools.
restore_and_remount.additional_reads: Inspect before/after App/pod/ReplicaSet/attachment ownership plus exact operator-owned restore Job UID and pod children; verify its App owner UID, own sole PVC, reviewed backup image, args[restore], successful condition, old service pod termination before restore mount and new service Ready. Project restore requested/completed/error status but no snapshot URL/S3 creds. Re-run inspect for encryption raw5Gi bound and kubelet stats after real remount/restore. If node or pod changes, rederive only from same App/PVC/PV binding.

cleanup_status.Kubernetes_mutations: Only backup-cleanup exact UID if still present. Service/PVC/PV deletion stays on the existing REST/operator finalizer path.
cleanup_status.reads: Verify old exact App UID, PVC UID, PV UID, LUKS Secret UID, CronJob UID and every recorded backup/restore/purge Job UID gone. A same-name new lifetime fails closed rather than being deleted. Capture VolumeAttachment removal and exact provider volume deletion through a read-only GET of the single parsed provider ID, if current inventory lacks that fact. Provider DELETE is never part of this harness.
cleanup_status.preservation: Compare metadata identities of all pre-create baseline services/disks; do not modify or repair them. Report asynchronous purge/provider deletion as pending until proven.

source_notes: Kubernetes DELETE supports UID preconditions; CLI delete by name alone is insufficient for this fixture protocol.

pods/exec and port-forward do not themselves offer a UID precondition. Recheck exact pod UID/containerID before and after every bounded fixed-argv exec; discard evidence on lifetime mismatch. Reviewed CSI container is trusted, and no arbitrary text/input is executable.

Current inventory projection lacks PV UID, workspace label, VolumeAttachment, service workload pod chain, Secret nonsecret fields, CronJob/Job identities and raw metrics. Extend only the fixture operation's projections, not broad tenant-data inventory.

Backing up a file tree does not prove physical capacity/encryption. File hashes and real operator restore, fixed node block metadata, real kubelet stats, APIs and rendered UI are separate evidence sources.
